Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

On oral request made by counsel for the petitioners, he is permitted to implead A.D.M. Finance and Revenue, Basti as respondent no.7.
2.
Notice on behalf of the said respondent has been accepted by learned standing counsel.

3. The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to consider the claim of the petitioners for award of compensation for having utilized an excess area Indramati @ Indumati And 7 Others vs Union Of India And 5 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129517884/
1 of 0.200 hectare of Arazi No. 277 and 0.015 hectare of Arazi 278, Village Uska, Tappa Padia,
Pargana Basti Purab, Tehsil Basti, Sadar, District Basti in widening of a road.

sentences.text: 4. On 31.07.2023, the following order was passed:-

"1. It is evident from the communication sent by District Magistrate, Basti addressed to Executive Engineer, National Highway No. 233, Biotech Ring Road, Vikas Nagar,
Lucknow that in the process of constructing the state national highway apart from covering gata no. 277, which was notified for acquisition, certain more area of gata no. 277 and another gata no. 278, total area 0.1753 hectare got affected.
He had directed the addressee to secure sale deeds on basis of mutual compromise from the tenure holders in respect of excess land.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the respondents have not paid any compensation to them so far nor have approached them for arriving at a compromise,
although their land was never acquired but has been utilised in constructing the road.
3. Ms. Kiran Bala, learned counsel appearing for respondent nos. 2 to 4 seeks time to obtain instructions and to file affidavit of respondent no.3 on the above aspect.
4. Accordingly, two weeks' time is allowed.

5. List on 17th August, 2023 as fresh."
5.
In compliance of the above order, an affidavit has been filed by the Project Director, NHAI.

It is admitted therein that in a joint survey got conducted by the respondents, it transpired that the respondents have utilized some land in excess of what was acquired under the provisions of the National Highways Act, 1956.

On 13.09.2023, the Project Director has sent a communication addressed to the Competent Authority, Land Acquisition, Basti for approval of the joint inspection report so that the compensation for excess land is determined and is paid to the petitioners.
6. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of NHAI states that as soon as the compensation amount is determined, necessary funds will be made available for payment of compensation to the petitioners.

7. Sri Rajeev Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel states that since excess land was not subject matter of the notification under the National Highways Act, 1956, therefore, compensation has to be determined by the Committee envisaged under Government Order dated 12.05.2016.
8. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to file a fresh representation before the Chairperson of the said Committee i.e. A.D.M. Finance and Revenue.
On such representation being filed, it will be placed before the said Committee for being decided in accordance with law, within a period of twelve weeks from the date the representation is filed.

(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 19.9.2023 SL  Indramati @ Indumati And 7 Others vs Union Of India And 5 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129517884/
